notes: COUSR00C as a LINKed program: the COMMAREA sibling of carddemo-userlist, which is a terminal transaction (CU00). No CardDemo program LINKs COUSR00C, but any program may, with a COMMAREA, and the det port's LINK-entry code (the DFHCOMMAREA copy-in, the COMMAREA hand-back, the abend path at level above 1) is reached only by such an entry (#6166: four det-mutation survivors of carddemo-userlist). The scenarios are ten of that case's inputs, each entered by LINK with STARTCODE D (IBM: a task started for a distributed program link, X19). Run it through the det port (`det_port.py run carddemo-userlist-linked --work DIR`: 10/10 scenarios equal, 16/16 paragraphs, 64/100 branches), never plain `equivalence.py run`: that runs the forge stub, whose runTask is the unported TODO body, so Java records only the final COMMAREA and every scenario reads 0/N equal (#6166). The det_mutation ledger still scores only the base case's scenarios. Data: usrsec.txt is carddemo-userlist's.
